B084CMPWST.title: Lutron Caseta Smart Lighting Auto On/Off Wireless Occupancy Motion Sensor
bullets: SENSING AND CONTROL: This smart motion sensor can automatically turn off any number of Caseta smart devices after you leave a room

ACTIVE HOURS FEATURE: Set the motion sensor switch to trigger lights based on time of day; use the Lutron app to customize when sensors are active, which lights the sensor controls, and light levels (Caseta Lutron Smart Hub, L-BDG2-WH, required)
VERSATILE AND POWERFUL: One Lutron motion sensor light switch can turn off any number of Caseta switches, dimmers, fan controls, and Serena smart shades within 60 ft.
BREAKTHROUGH SENSING TECHNOLOGY: This Lutron motion sensor switch detects fine motion 3X better than other sensors; has 180° field of view
LIGHT SENSOR SWITCH WITH LONG-LASTING BATTERY LIFE: 10 year typical battery life, 3x longer than the industry average for smart home devices

PLACE IT ANYWHERE: Use this motion sensor Lutron switch freestanding on a flat surface or mount to a wall or corner, perfect for bathrooms, laundry rooms, hallways, garages, and more - no wires required
CUSTOMIZABLE: Set your desired level for each device controlled by the motion detector light switch
